verdict.rationale: The official Firebase CLI ships a `login:ci` command that generates an auth token for non-interactive environments, so headless use in CI is a first-party feature. The CLI also deploys code with one command, and the Local Emulator Suite plus Test SDK support automated integration and unit testing without touching production. Missing for 10: in-depth CI setup documentation (e.g. CI-provider guides or service-account auth flows) and independent hands-on reports of running Firebase in CI pipelines.
